history.administration_response: Technical policies and guidelines are reviewed on a regular basis following a schedule established by the Information and Communications Technology Policy Committee. Policy owners are identified and informed when policies need to be reviewed. The Office of Information and Communications Technology will provide the latest quarterly report, indicating the responsible policy owners. The policy revision is an ongoing process. The Administration considers this recommendation to be implemented and requests its closure by the Board.
history.board_assessment: Given that supporting documents have been provided in April 2024, the Board considers this recommendation to be implemented.
